id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier used in checklists and CLI flags.

title.description: Human-readable title; the only field guaranteed to survive a rename.

description.description: Plain-English description of what this item is and why it exists.

type.description: Item kind; 'question' prompts discovery input, 'task' is a checklist item, 'decision' records a sign-off, 'evidence' is an artifact to attach, 'owners' names a human.

default_owner.description: Suggested role/team to own this item, lowercase.

example_response.description: Optional short example of a complete response, used only as a placeholder pattern, never a real customer statement.

see_also.description: Optional cross-references to other items (by id) or to documents (by relative path).
